issues.title: PCV-related mixture DTCs on documented 2004/2007/2009 petrol 9-5
issues.cause: Factory PCV diagrams document check-valve, external trap and multiple hose flow paths; leaks may contribute to DTCs, but no single code identifies the failing component.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect individual oil-trap hoses, clips, boost check valve and intake leaks, alongside other DTC causes and actual operating data.
issues.correction_summary: Correct the specifically diagnosed leak or damaged part with year/VIN-verified factory parts and service procedure.
limits: No code provides standalone confirmation of PCV failure.
No evidence of fleet incidence or approved retrofit.
Factory web text describing 'new' PCV in 2007/2009 is copied from design context, not proof of annual redesigned hardware.

issues.title: FA57 gearbox identity must precede contamination campaign assessment
issues.cause: Saab distinguishes FA57 gearbox code/manufacture data and TCM hardware from vehicle chassis boundaries; campaign applicability is not established by model year alone.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record real VIN body and chassis suffix, installed gearbox type designation, transmission-fluid history and cooler replacement invoices; obtain professional contamination testing when evidence warrants.
issues.correction_summary: Resolve applicability and condition; verified coolant/ATF mixing under TA440-0702 requires trained transmission repair evaluation, not routine fluid-only treatment.
limits: No gearbox swap or TCM programming approval.
The 'up to VIN below' test is a strict cutoff and differs from separate CSP15446 campaign inclusion.
Do not use the bulletin's open-flame ATF sample demonstration as a DIY test.
